run_mcc_demo: run the MCC demo to generate 3D occupancy predictions from an image and point cloud OBJ file
run_viz_predictions: run visualization to predict occupancy and colors for unseen 3D points using the MCC model
pad_image_tensor: pad a 3D image tensor to a square shape by zero-padding along the shorter dimension
normalize_point_cloud: normalize 3D point cloud coordinates by dividing by standard deviation and subtracting the mean
main_entry: run the main entry point that loads an image, point cloud, and segmentation mask to generate 3D predictions
